As discussed in Part II, Item 9B, Other Information—xAI Investment of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, the Company entered into an agreement in January 2026 to make a minority equity investment.

On January 16, 2026, following review in a manner consistent with the Board’s fiduciary duties and the Company’s related party transactions policy (the “RPT Policy”), Tesla entered into an agreement to invest approximately $2 billion to acquire shares of Series E Preferred Stock of xAI as part of xAI’s recent publicly-disclosed financing round.
